description: This file defines Express.js route handlers for retrieving activity logs related to courses, users, logins, and instructors in an LMS backend.

methods.name: GET /activity
methods.description: Handles retrieval of recent system activity including course publications, user registrations, and logins, limited by query parameter.

methods.name: GET /activity/instructors
methods.description: Retrieves instructor data along with their course counts, for admin users.
